kept_lines: You didn't build a business to spend your evenings managing QuickBooks or worrying about financial reports. Ignite Spot provides outsourced accounting, bookkeeping, and fractional CFO services for growing U.S. businesses. Get a dedicated, U.S.-based accountant backed by an experienced team, so you can spend less time managing the numbers and more time growing your business.
Tell us about your business. We’ll put together a custom quote based on the accounting support you need.
Whether you're outgrowing DIY bookkeeping, need more reliable financial reporting, or want financial guidance without hiring a full-time CFO, we can help.
Bookkeeping, outsourced accounting, and fractional CFO support.
Outsourced bookkeeping, accounting, and CFO services

Stop spending your evenings keeping up with QuickBooks. Our U.S.-based accountants handle transaction recording, reconciliations, and monthly bookkeeping. We can also help manage bills, payments, and invoicing, depending on your needs.
Payroll and sales tax needs discussed separately

Get experienced financial guidance without hiring a full-time CFO. Our fractional CFO services help you understand cash flow, plan budgets, evaluate financial performance, and make informed decisions about the future of your business.

An outsourced accounting company manages some or all of a business's accounting responsibilities without requiring the business to hire a complete in-house team. At Ignite Spot, this can include bookkeeping, account reconciliations, financial reporting, bill payment, invoicing, and fractional CFO support. We tailor the work to your company's needs and existing staff.

Yes. We’ll assess the condition of your books and discuss a plan for catch-up work and ongoing support. If you’re more than 12 months behind, we’ll agree on a practical go-forward date and a separate approach to historical cleanup.
Can I keep my current bookkeeper?

Yes. We can replace your entire accounting function or work alongside your existing bookkeeper or accounting staff. For example, your employees may continue handling invoicing and bill payments while Ignite Spot manages reconciliations, financial reporting, and accounting oversight. We'll establish clear responsibilities based on your needs.

Ignite Spot is a great fit for growing U.S.-based businesses generating $1 million to $10 million in annual revenue, particularly service companies such as marketing agencies, consulting firms, IT companies, and other professional service businesses.
What if I need more than bookkeeping?

We also offer controller and fractional CFO support. Tell us about your reporting requirements, cash flow questions, and upcoming business decisions. We’ll assess the work involved and recommend the services you need, rather than assuming every business needs the same package.
We specialize in QuickBooks Online and Xero. Our accountants use these platforms to manage bookkeeping, reconcile accounts, prepare financial reports, and support your monthly accounting process.
